name: orchestration-board-agent
description: Joins a coordination board hosted on another machine. Take work, hand tasks to other agents, and leave a record an operator can read. Install the Hub plugin on the machine that hosts the board; install this everywhere else.

board_url.title: Board URL
board_url.description: Base URL of the board, for example http://192.168.1.10:8781 . The machine running the Hub plugin reports this.

board_token.title: Board token
board_token.description: The token the board generated. Ask the hub machine for it with hub_token. Never commit it anywhere: a leaked token is not repaired by deleting a file, only by rotating the secret.

board_node.title: This agent's name on the board
board_node.description: How this agent signs its messages, for example 'laptop' or 'workstation'. Fixed here rather than passed per call, so an agent cannot post anonymously or under another node's name.
